author: Vox
description:
The pork industry routinely confines pregnant pigs in tiny enclosures called gestation crates. The practice has drawn bipartisan opposition, with lawmakers from both parties pushing back against the Save Our Bacon Act — a bill that would override state laws banning the crates.

Read more: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/493710/gestation-crates-farm-bill-save-our-bacon-republicans

author: Vox
description:
Elon Musk has been repeatedly posting about Citizen Vigilante, an obscure movie that dramatizes a racist and anti-immigrant fantasy: that Western countries are being “invaded” by migrants, and that vigilante violence is the answer. 

Vox’s Constance Grady explains why Musk’s obsession with the film is so alarming — and what it says about the power of the platform he bought.
